mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user` (username, password, nickname, email, phone, role, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{role}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE `user` SET nickname = #{nickname}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `user` SET password = #{password}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `user` SET avatar = #{avatar}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `user` SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
